name: ori
description: Git-native product graphs, local semantic search, portable projections and isolated source execution.

interface.shortDescription: Shape product graphs and build from intent
interface.longDescription: Keep product intent in Git files. Explore and edit the graph through Codex skills and a local React interface, find related requirements with on-device multilingual search, export immutable projections, and execute source changes in isolated Git worktrees. The plugin bundles standalone macOS, Linux and Windows binaries for x64 and ARM64, selected by a launcher without a build toolchain.
defaultPrompt: Use $ori:install to set up this project.
Use $ori:open to explore this product graph.
Use $ori:change to update the product intent.
